issues.description: Ingest commits valid rows before enforcing the malformed-row threshold, so a failed ingest can still partially mutate the database.
Elapsed parsing rejects valid Slurm formats such as MM:SS and DD-MM:SS.
Failure reports look for OOM instead of Slurm's OUT_OF_MEMORY state, so real OOM jobs are omitted.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited columns are accepted silently because DictReader stores overflow fields under None and the parser never checks it.
Report commands create and initialize a new empty database when the requested DB path is wrong, hiding operator mistakes.
Using job_id as the only primary key overwrites duplicate/requeued accounting records and cannot preserve run history.
GPU counting sums every gres/gpu-prefixed TRES, which can double-count when generic and typed GPU TRES are both present.
Timestamps are validated but not normalized, so mixed timezone-aware and naive ISO strings will compare incorrectly as SQLite text.
The malformed-threshold test asserts the nonzero exit but does not assert that the failed ingest left the database unchanged.
